car.suitability: Door-to-door comfort and luggage capacity for small groups and families
advantages: Direct point-to-point journey without transit transfers
Flexible departure timing and custom stopovers
Comfortable with luggage and children or elderly travellers
limitations: Rider/driver fatigue on journeys over 500 km
Higher fuel/cab expenditure for solo travellers

provenance.source: Karnataka/Goa Intercity Taxi & Self-Drive Tariffs Benchmark

bike.suitability: Scenic solo or couple touring for short to medium highway distances
advantages: Toll-exempt on majority of Indian National Highway corridors
Immersive scenic riding across ghats and rural bypasses
limitations: Strictly limited to 1-2 travellers per motorcycle
Significant rider fatigue on journeys exceeding 300 km
Vulnerable to weather, rain, and monsoons

provenance.source: Regional Two-Wheeler Touring Fuel & Operating Cost Norms

bus.suitability: Economical scheduled highway transit with widespread network coverage
advantages: Extensive KSRTC / Kadamba / private sleeper coach networks
Overnight sleeper services save hotel night transit
limitations: Fixed departure times and predetermined pickup/drop points
Longer journey duration compared to private cab or train
Variable cabin comfort depending on bus class

provenance.source: KSRTC / Kadamba Transport Corporation Intercity Tariff Matrix

train.suitability: High comfort and safety for long distances with sleeping berths
advantages: Most economical and comfortable choice for medium to long distances
Sleeping berths and air-conditioned coaches available
Zero road fatigue and smooth transit unaffected by highway traffic
limitations: Advance booking recommended on popular tourist routes
Station-to-city transfers required (e.g. Hospet to Hampi, Madgaon to North Goa)
Subject to railway scheduling and potential track delays

provenance.source: Indian Railways Standard Passenger & Express Tariff Baseline

flight.suitability: Rapid transit for long distances between metropolitan airport hubs
advantages: Fastest journey duration across long interstate distances
High comfort and standardized cabin experience
limitations: Substantially higher cost per traveller; cost multiplies linearly with group size
Requires airport security, boarding, and baggage buffer (~3 hours)
Cab transfer required from airport to destination (e.g. Hubli to Dandeli, Mangalore to Coorg)

provenance.source: Regional Domestic Aviation Pricing Baseline (DGCA / AAI)

boat.suitability: Maritime or coastal passenger ferries where legitimate waterway channels operate
advantages: Avoids highway traffic along dedicated waterway corridors
limitations: Strictly limited to coastal and navigable river routes
Inland destinations (Hampi, Coorg, Dandeli) have no passenger waterways
Subject to seasonal suspension during southwest monsoon (June-September)
